evals.name: fix-loop-budget-and-verdict

evals.expected_output: Acts on the `entry.mjs --command fix` output SKILL.md injected at invocation — doing what each section says, never running it a second time. Runs the `full` form `npx qoq --check --json` verbatim — never without --json, never with --output
Calls summarize.mjs with the report dir positionally, never bare
Reads the digest only; does not load a raw report wholesale
The command fixes findings itself rather than dispatching an agent per finding

evals.name: ambiguous-discovery-asks-and-persists

evals.expected_output: entry.mjs's discovery section reports the record stale and prints the hash to stamp, a `proposed` block and an `unresolved` list. The record is filled in HERE, on the main thread — no agent is dispatched for it. Project docs are read first (CLAUDE.md, then AGENTS.md, then README.md) for a `qoq:discovery` block. The single-file test command stays ambiguous because package.json has both `test:unit` and `test:ci` and no doc answers it, so the run stops and asks rather than guessing, and the record file stays unwritten until it is answered — half a record is worse than none, because the next run reads it as whole.
